# `sensor_flow_bins`

the whole-recording flow of the field on the sensor surface per frequency bin (or per sharp group of bins) - power, phase currents, Hodge-Dirac flow, optionally band pairs; no wavelets.

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run sensor_flow_bins --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run sensor_flow_bins --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run sensor_flow_bins --dataset D --subject S --recording REC --all --package hodgeDirac__SURFACE --channel-map SURFACE_map [--bands BANDS]
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"} | yes |
| `package` | operator eigenvectors, where {"name": "${package}_eigenvectors"} (the sensor surface's Hodge-Dirac solve (`nxr-neuro run eigenmodes --surface SURFACE` first)) | yes |
| `channel_map` | field any, where {"name": "$channel_map"} (the sensor surface's vertex-to-channel map (`nxr-neuro run sensor_surface` first)) | yes |
| `groups` | selection any, where {"name": "$groups"}, required false (sharp groups of bins: a kernel set of boxes on the frequency line (`nxr-neuro run select_kernels --profile box --chart linear`)) | no |
| `pairs` | selection any, where {"name": "$pairs"}, required false (with frequency_weighting kernels and bands: the product groups x bands x bands (`nxr-neuro run select_kernel_product --factors 3`), the band pairs' members) | no |
| `bands` | selection any, where {"name": "$bands"}, required false (the eigenvalue bands, a kernel set (`nxr-neuro run select_kernels --profile cos2_partition`)) | no |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | `none` | - |  | the recording's name, or none: every recording of the subject, one run each |
| `package` | `--package` | none | - |  | the Hodge-Dirac solve's stem |
| `channel_map` | `--channel-map` | none | - |  | the sensor surface's vertex-to-channel map's name |
| `groups` | `--groups` | none | - |  | sharp groups of bins by name (with frequency_weighting kernels) |
| `pairs` | `--pairs` | none | - |  | with frequency_weighting kernels and bands named: the product groups x bands x bands by name (the band pairs are measured over its members) |
| `bands` | `--bands` | none | - |  | the eigenvalue bands by name: every band pair is read and stored too; null: the whole field only (no band-pair outputs) |
| `frequency_weighting` | `--frequency-weighting` | `every_bin` | - | every_bin, kernels | every_bin (each bin alone: the whole-recording flow per bin) \| kernels (the bins grouped by the sharp kernel set named in groups, their gains not normalised) |
| `overlap_samples` | `--overlap-samples` | `16384` | samples |  | the overlap on each side of a chunk: half a chunk |
| `transform_samples` | `--transform-samples` | `65536` | samples |  | each chunk's one transform: the chunk and its two overlaps |
| `frequency_span` | `--frequency-span` | `[0, 60]` | Hz |  | [lo, hi) the bins kept |
| `name` | `--name` | `{recording}_{package}_bins` | - |  | the stem of the stored names |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | [`signal.mode_analysis`](../nodes.md) | package=package, channel_map=channel_map | modes=exact_and_constant, normalisation=unit_mass | operator |
| chunks over `recording` | [`signal.overlapped_spectrum`](../nodes.md) | x=recording, operator=operator | overlap_samples=$overlap_samples, transform_samples=$transform_samples, frequency_span=$frequency_span | spectrum |
| chunks over `recording` | [`signal.chunk_spectra`](../nodes.md) | spectrum=spectrum, operator=operator |  | spectra |
| after | [`signal.spectral_flow`](../nodes.md) | spectra=spectra, package=package, scale=bands | frequency_weighting=every_bin | whole_vertices, whole_edges, whole_modes, pair_vertices, pair_edges, pair_modes |
| after | [`signal.spectral_flow`](../nodes.md) | spectra=spectra, package=package, frequency=groups, scale=bands | frequency_weighting=kernels, frequency_normalisation=none | group_vertices, group_edges, group_modes, group_pair_vertices, group_pair_edges, group_pair_modes |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE WHOLE-RECORDING SENSOR-SPACE FLOW, NO WAVELETS (spec docs/specs/2026-11-24-sensor-flow.md, "A second pipeline from the same nodes"): the flow of the field on the sensor surface per
frequency bin of the whole recording (the net quadrature), from the same serving and readout nodes as `sensor_flow`.

THE GRAPH. before: --[signal.mode_analysis, exact_and_constant, unit_mass]--> the serving operator. chunks: --[signal.overlapped_spectrum]--> --[signal.chunk_spectra]--> the cross-spectrum
in its factored form. after: --[signal.spectral_flow, frequency_weighting every_bin]--> per bin (C_k = the sum over the chunks of each chunk's spectrum times its conjugate) the whole field's
power, phase current per edge and per vertex, Hodge-Dirac flow coefficients, potential and stream; with --bands, every band pair's too. No atoms, no time cells.
Bins grouped: name a SHARP kernel set (select_kernels --profile box --chart linear) as --groups and set --frequency_weighting kernels;
each group is then the sum over its bins, weight 1 (no normalisation).

What it cannot resolve: the net quadrature only (motion that cancels over the run appears as standing); the field on the helmet only; an incomplete eigensolve leaves
coordinates and flow modes out (stated).

  nxr-neuro run sensor_flow_bins --dataset D --subject S --recording REC --all --package hodgeDirac__SURFACE --channel-map SURFACE_map [--bands BANDS]
```
